recommendation: Keep the commit. Future authoritative ChargeItem resource maintenance should happen in HL7/admin-incubator; broader MonetaryComponent ModelInfo alignment for Invoice or ChargeItemDefinition should be handled under FHIR-16380 or a dedicated related reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-21001 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked ChargeItem to represent monetary amounts by replacing priceOverride with totalPriceComponent, adding unitPriceComponent, removing factorOverride, and changing overrideReason from string to CodeableConcept.
initial_application: Commit 8b936b6829832c19b4cf616dbdd6e9a1f6986a9a applied the ChargeItem source change before R5 publication, updating the StructureDefinition, example, and search parameters. The R5 ChargeItem source used MonetaryComponent for the new pricing fields because FHIR-16380 created the shared metadata type.
additional_context: FHIR-16380 explicitly listed ChargeItem.totalPriceComponent and ChargeItem.unitPriceComponent as users of MonetaryComponent. ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition were later removed from active core resource inputs by commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 and moved to the HL7 Administrative Incubator IG. The current core Library/FHIR-ModelInfo example remained active and stale, still exposing ChargeItem.factorOverride, ChargeItem.priceOverride, and string overrideReason.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to define PriceComponentType and MonetaryComponent, expose ChargeItem.unitPriceComponent and ChargeItem.totalPriceComponent as FHIR.MonetaryComponent, and change ChargeItem.overrideReason to FHIR.CodeableConcept. Removed core ChargeItem resource files were not restored.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: added PriceComponentType and MonetaryComponent ModelInfo entries, added PriceComponentType conversion info, and replaced ChargeItem.factorOverride/priceOverride/string overrideReason with unitPriceComponent/totalPriceComponent MonetaryComponent fields and CodeableConcept overrideReason.

related_jiras.note: Created MonetaryComponent and explicitly listed the two FHIR-21001 ChargeItem pricing fields as users of that metadata type.
